## Ingredients

- Dates 
- Peanut butter or nut butter of your choice 
- Chocolate 
- (Optional) anything else you want to add

## Instructions

Remove the pit from the date, add peanute butter, top in chocolate, anything else you want. Enjoy!

## Lisa's notes

Sometimes you need an easy desert, and this fits the bill.
